versions.changelog:
## Joja Junk Mail 1.0

First release.

- A JojaMart advertising letter arrives every Wednesday morning: sixteen different letters a year, four per season, on the Joja letter paper. From year 2 on, an anniversary letter replaces the welcome letter.
- The letters are just for fun: no items, no money, no effect on the game.
- They stop once the Community Center is restored or the Joja community development form is completed.

## Joja Junk Mail 1.1

Now in German too.

- All 17 letters and their titles are translated into German. Players with the game set to German get the German letters; everyone else keeps the English ones.
- Same letters, same Wednesdays, nothing else changes.

## Joja Junk Mail 1.2

Festival letters.

- JojaMart now writes before every festival too: eleven new letters a year, one shortly before each festival, from the Egg Festival to the Feast of the Winter Star, including the Trout Derby, SquidFest and the Night Market. In English and German.
- A festival letter arrives the day before the festival, or two days before when that day is a Wednesday, so there is never more than one Joja letter on the same morning.
- The Wednesday letters stay as they are, and all letters still stop once the Community Center is restored or the Joja community development form is completed.
